newsitem.title: USA: American Healthcorp unit spinoff delayed.
newsitem.headline: American Healthcorp unit spinoff delayed.

text.p: Diabetes care provider American Healthcorp said Tuesday it has delayed plans to spin off its AmSurg Corp. ambulatory surgery centre unit because of tax complications.

The Nashville, Tenn.-based company said the Internal Revenue Service will not be permit the transaction to be completed on a tax-free basis. American Healthcorp owns 59 percent of AmSurg common stock.
American Healthcorp had proposed spinning off AmSurg by distributing all of its AmSurg stock to American Healthcorp stockholders, it said.
The company said it is submitting to the IRS a new plan that it hopes will result in a reversal of the agency's current stance.

The delay in the distribution should not have an adverse effect upon either AmSurg or American Healthcorp's other unit, Diabetes Treatment Centres of America Inc., company Chairman and Chief Executive Thomas Cigarran said in a statement.
AmSurg develops, acquires and manages physician practice-based ambulatory surgery centres and speciality physician networks in partnership with surgical and other group practices.
American Healthcorp stock was down 85.5 cents at $10.50 in midday trading on Nasdaq.
